steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: But next, I need someone in that world to distract her to buy me more time. Chief, can you help me with that?
You did your best, researching and setting traps in advance. If you can foil her assassination attempt and force her to rewind, you can buy more time for Moore.
But now it seems the odds are slim.
000 grins at you, seemingly seeing through your thoughts. Since reaching the new world, she has grown so much, easily eliminating anyone in her way... and now, she even holds all the "permissions."

She can turn the Sinners into bizarre forms, trap them in dreams, lock them in the web, or chuck them into various rifts. Even if you band together to turn the tide, she can easily launch a rewind and delete all your progress, and you can't do a thing about it.
Sometimes you just can't help it, but we still keep going nevertheless.
Can it really not be helped? Will all these efforts be in vain?
...Maybe there's another possibility?
(Flashback)
The blackout just now caught the gods' attention. They will soon investigate and find EMP's Mania arrows. Hehe... the consequences should be exciting.
(Flashback)
...Sigh, causing such a ruckus again. They're really something, charging around recklessly, and not letting me relax for a moment.
Chief, get ready, I'm going to rewind.
(Flashback)
Each rewind is launched when you successfully stop her. You thought she did this to avoid admitting defeat, but when the assassination of Config Duck failed, she didn't immediately rewind.
Probably... the timing of the rewind isn't directly related to defeat, but rather...
(Flashback)

steps.speaker: I'm telling him everything! You won't get your hands on me!!
steps.content: Mania is not allowed in the realm of the gods, who enforce the rules to the letter.
In the last adventure, your companions recklessly broke the rules and narrowly escaped being punished by the gods. This time around, to prevent any mishaps, I've adopted safety measures for everyone.
(Flashback)

steps.speaker: Choice
options: The purpose of the rewind is to prevent Mania from being exposed.

steps.content: This thought flashes in your mind, and you immediately want to verify it and buy time for the operation. However...
It's too late. If there's no Sinner around to help you...
(Flashback)
Alright. Mania is forbidden in this world. Using the shackle will cause a crisis. Put it away, okay?
(Flashback)

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I should have tried this sooner.
The shackles collide with an invisible wall in front of you, shattering and dispersing. But you don't stop, giving it your all once more.
The narrow space shakes, and you feel a wave of dizziness. Meanwhile, a spot on the glass wall seems to loosen. You feel encouraged by this.
What are you doing...?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You don't want us to use our powers, or have the gods discover signs of Mania. You insist that such actions would incur dire consequences.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So I want to see what consequences could make you act so cautiously. I want to see what could scare the fearless 000.
[Glitch]

Mustering all your strength, you finally break the ever-present wall in front of you. Amidst dizzying noises, blinding light and quaking, you feel like suffocating mud has filled your lungs instead of air.
But you made it out, and your power has returned.
Stop it!
000 raises her hand quickly, causing the entire isolated space to quake. This is her signature move before launching a rewind. You've successfully forced her hand, and she's being cornered.
She's in such a rush that she doesn't escape the truth in time...
[Black Screen]
Just before everything rolls back and whisks you away to the past, you are engulfed in darkness. A certain kind of being chases up, blocking your path with immense pressure.

steps.speaker: Blurry Echo
steps.content: Er▌▌▌detect▌
You can't understand its words, see its form, or even sense its existence. This thing is unlike any enemy you've encountered before. It...

steps.speaker: Blurry Echo
steps.content: ▌▌▌activate▌ clear▌▌
Before you can process it, a powerful force surges toward you. Just as it's about to tear you apart, 000's halo flashes before you.
